name: Eurofins Vulnerability Disclosure Engagement
notes: VDP — hall of fame only, no monetary rewards. Scope: 'All Eurofins Assets' — interpreted as all *.eurofins.com + all country-TLD variants listed in in_scope. 950+ labs, 59 countries, 65,000 staff, 450M tests/year. Known tech: Bootstrap, Select2, jQuery. No credentials provided — external threat model. Register with @bugcrowdninja.com email where account creation is possible. THROTTLE: max ~5 req/s, jitter 200-800ms — production environment, other users active. STOP AND REPORT if you encounter patient health data, clinical diagnostic results, or pharmaceutical compliance data — do not read/copy it. Do NOT modify or delete data. Business logic high-value: IDOR on test result/order IDs (clinical data exposure), cross-tenant isolation between lab clients in B2B portals, workflow bypass in ordering systems, subdomain takeover (massive estate, likely stale CNAMEs). Out-of-scope finding classes: missing HTTP headers (unless exploitable), CSRF on logout or anonymous/non-sensitive actions, clickjacking without impact, content spoofing without code execution, known-vuln libraries without PoC, SSL/TLS best practices, missing CSP/HSTS/HttpOnly-on-non-sensitive, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, low-impact host headers, software version disclosure, tabnabbing, open redirect alone (needs secondary impact), open ports without direct vuln, automated reports without PoC, expired/invalid credentials, outdated-browser-only issues, email enumeration, CSV injection without PoC, third-party integrations. VRT out of scope: Application-Level DoS, CSRF Logout, XSS IE-Only, Physical Security, P5 informational. Duplicates: same vuln across multiple paths/endpoints treated as one — submit the strongest instance only. Every report must include: role used for testing, exact reproduction steps, clear impact statement, no AI-generated filler.
